prompt:
Draw ONE retro pixel-art CLOUDY weather badge on completely flat magenta #FF00FF. This will become a tiny 24x24 icon: use only about TWENTY-TWO equal square pixel columns for the entire drawing, as if drawing at 24x24 and zooming up. NOT detailed pixel art. No antialias, gradients, noise or texture. Make the icon on a large square image with magenta margin.
COMPOSITION: a SMALL gold sun upper-left BEHIND a MUCH BROADER pale blue-white cloud. Sun disk about 7 logical pixels wide, three attached short square rays at top, upper-left and left; dark navy outline. Cloud in foreground across bottom two-thirds. Cloud is 19 logical pixels wide and 10 high. Its top MUST have THREE DISTINCT LOBES with visibly DEEP valleys: left lobe a flat 4-pixel cap at mid-height; a clear 2-pixel-wide 2-pixel-deep notch; centre lobe a flat 5-pixel cap slightly taller; another clear 2-pixel-wide 2-pixel-deep notch; right lobe a flat 4-pixel cap back at mid-height. This produces unmistakable puffs rather than a sloping hill. Do not fill the valleys with cloud colour. The cloud has short vertical outer sides, shallow horizontal underside, not a mountain or triangle. Navy one-logical-pixel outline around outside AND a continuous navy line at sun/cloud overlap. Cloud pale #CEDBDE, a restrained #92AAB8 shade only on bottom edge and lower-right, no diagonal mountain shadow. Gold sun #E8B753, upper-left highlight #FFF0B0, outline #202936. No detached rays or stray flecks. No rain, snow, text or secondary symbols. Equal square pixels, same dark one-pixel outline throughout. Variant G, with clear cloud humps and deep notches surviving downsampling.
